Hi Elena / Atlas procurement team,

Thanks for your interest in working with Redwood. To get your account live in our vendor registry so we can route purchase orders and remit payments we need a short set of details and a couple of supporting documents. I attached the vendor master form and an onboarding checklist to this message, and you can also complete the secure portal if that's easier (link below).

What we need from you (short checklist):
- Legal entity name exactly as on tax docs
- Country of incorporation + Certificate of Incorporation (scan/pdf)
- Tax ID / VAT number (W-9 or local equivalent)
- Remittance address (billing address for invoices)
- Primary AP contact name, email, phone
- Preferred payment rails (ACH / Wire) and ACH details if applicable
- Preferred invoice routing email and whether you accept PO-backed invoices or EDI

Please return the completed form or upload to the portal by EOD Tuesday, Feb 24 so we can create your master record and set up PO routing. If you prefer a quick call to walk through the fields I can loop in Kimberly from AP.

Portal: https://redwood-secure-portal.example.com/vendor-enroll/atlas-forms?token=zt8b4
Attachments: vendor_master_form.xlsx (form), redwood_onboarding_instructions.pdf (instructions)

Thanks,
David

2) For ACH: we generally provide wire details only for customers outside the US. Is wire transfer acceptable for initial onboarding?
3) Are you able to accept invoices routed to invoices+atlas@atlasinstruments.com (shared mailbox)?

Hi Elena — good questions. Short answers below, and Kimberly from AP is looped in to confirm payment routing.

1) Please populate the master record with the legal name that will appear on invoices and W-9 (Atlas Instruments, Inc.) — that makes the PO / invoice match deterministic for our ERP. If your remittance bank is different (parent-level accounts) include the parent entity and routing in the remittance/banking section of the form and mark the field "Alternate remittance / parent entity".
2) Wire transfers are fine for onboarding; Kimberly, can you confirm any additional KYC we need for a MX-based receiving account (or if a US-dollar correspondent bank is required)?
3) Yes, invoices+atlas@atlasinstruments.com is fine. We'll create a PO routing rule to accept invoices from that address and mark it as the primary invoice pathway.

Next steps:
- Elena / Atlas: finish the portal or attach the completed vendor_master_form.xlsx back to this thread.
- Kimberly/AP: I'll hand-off the verification packet once the form and tax docs are in place; then we create the master record and enable PO routing.

If helpful, I'm available for a 20-min call tomorrow morning PST.

Best,
David
